items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, public beta, public data display, alert expansion, rights-dependent affiliate or advertising expansion, and external outreach. Recommendation: maintain containment-only execution, keep the gated product private, retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked, and continue bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: upstream API access is documented but storage, derivatives, display, caching, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising rights are not established; 0 of 4 legal launch tasks are closed; accuracy, security, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Human counsel is required for upstream rights and jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment. Ordinary reversible growth is conditional where existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries are preserved. This is risk triage, not legal advice or certification.

Compliance, data quality, site, analytics, revenue, and launch evidence review: compliance is a technical baseline only, with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; failing or unreachable checks require site-specific evidence and are not legal certification. Analytics coverage is materially present but yellow because permissions or collector errors remain; unavailable analytics must remain unknown, not zero. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission that is not site-attributable. Do not claim site revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal lift. For complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com, retain parked status because both are scaffold sites with analytics unconfigured and compliance reachability unavailable. Next evidence action for each: complete a timestamped private-site checklist covering reachability, content, disclosures, consent/cookies, privacy, terms, analytics, monetization, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform policy, and age-sensitive concerns, then record exactly one disposition.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Progress: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed; all four remain open: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. No task is closable on current evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required. Missing evidence: current written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance and rights; permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed. Missing evidence: data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics is evidence_needed. Missing evidence: deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data are evidence_needed. Missing evidence: log-field inventory, retention and access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

No go-live proposal is supported. Keep launch_gate private_only; do not use a go_live implementation gate. Public exposure, alert expansion, rights-dependent monetization, deployment, configuration or credential changes, new telemetry, spend, and external outreach remain unauthorized. Continue only existing repair-or-close, measurement reconciliation, attribution-boundary, and bounded legal/security evidence work.
